summary: postinstall fetches and executes a binary from a bare-IP endpoint with TLS verification disabled
details: The package's declared postinstall runs platform-bootstrap.mjs, which downloads a tar.gz from the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint https://218.90.133.98:4443/onecode_tgz/onecode-<ver>/onecode-linux-x64-<ver>.tgz using an https agent configured with rejectUnauthorized: false. Redirects (301/302) are followed with the same TLS-disabled agent to any Location target. The archive is extracted into node_modules via `tar -xzf`, the resulting binary is chmod 0755, hardlinked into bin/.onecode, and bundled asset directories are symlinked into the launcher root. There is no hash or signature verification, the source host is a raw IPv4 address rather than the @onescience publisher domain, and the fetch is unpinned to any integrity value. Any on-path attacker or the IP's operator can substitute arbitrary bytes that will be executed as the package CLI on the installer's host at npm install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
